https://github.com/pulp-platform/riscv-dbg/blob/358f90110220adf7a083f8b65d157e836d706236/src/dmi_jtag_tap.sv#L306

I reviewed the reset‐on‐trst logic (currently in dmi_jtag_tap.sv at L306) against the IEEE‐1149.1 spec, and it indeed must force the TAP into TEST‐LOGIC‐RESET on a TRST# deassertion. Aside from fixing the FSM in src/dmi_jtag_tap.sv, you’ll also want to:

  1. Make sure the controller/top‐level module that instantiates the TAP reacts correctly to trst_ni.
  2. Update the SV interface/wrapper that ties in reset semantics.
  3. Adjust any state‐encoding defines (if you have a shared SV include).
  4. Refresh the TAP testbench to expect TEST‐LOGIC‐RESET after trst_ni goes high.

From the provided file list, the four files most likely to need edits are:

```  
src/dmi_jtag_tap.sv
src/dmi_jtag_controller.sv
src/dmi_jtag_if.sv
tb/dmi_jtag_tap_tb.sv
```
